source_metadata.date_policy: Preserve original registry date strings and ACTUAL/ESTIMATED labels; no day/month/year imputation. Training excludes partial dates.
source_metadata.missingness_policy: Source-missing values remain missing. criteria_count and text_complexity are not invented.
limitations: Not a frozen historical baseline snapshot.
Not a population-representative or exhaustive registry export.
Completed-trial restriction creates selection bias; no censored trials are represented.
Results support a reproducible retrospective workflow demonstration, not validated prospective or clinical claims.
The live API may change. Exact bundled-data reproduction uses the preserved raw responses and checksums.

cohort.outcomes: completed actual completion minus start date in days

validation_partition.method: Earlier tuning / later calibration, split by whole start-date calendar-day groups near the halfway group
validation_partition.reason: Independent later validation groups reserved for calibration; no refit on tuning/calibration.

temporal_cutoffs.policy: Whole start-date groups. Training outcomes precede original validation cutoff; all original validation outcomes precede test cutoff. Earlier retained validation tunes; later groups calibrate when sufficient. No refit on validation or calibration. Tuning outcomes are available at the test cutoff, not necessarily the calibration start date.

training_support.method: Training-only observed numeric ranges, central 98% marginal ranges, text lengths and categorical levels

recommendation.reason: Lowest raw tuning validation Brier score among enabled fitted models; exact ties use model name. Calibration/test data are not used. This risk recommendation does not establish the best duration regressor or prospective clinical validity.

duration_recommendation.reason: Lowest tuning validation RMSE; ties use model name. Duration and prolonged-risk recommendations are independent; no calibration or test selection.

pci.interpretation: Descriptive cohort-relative index, not a validated probability or clinical score. Missing values use training medians; constant training components contribute zero.

warning: Research decision support only. Completed-only cohort creates follow-up/selection bias; minimum sample guard is not evidence of scientific validity. RETROSPECTIVE SNAPSHOT: baseline feature availability is unverified; post-start registry updates and narrative text may leak outcome information. Do not claim prospective validation.
limitations: Tuning validation metrics are optimistic after hyperparameter and raw model selection; test metrics are held out. Calibration diagnostics are in-sample for the calibration transform.
Bootstrap intervals are conditional on the fitted models and assume independent trials; they exclude model-fitting uncertainty and sponsor/site clustering.

Primary probabilities and classification metrics remain raw. Separate sigmoid-calibrated probabilities/metrics exist only with at least 10 calibration rows and two labels of each class; calibration never selects models.

Split-conformal nominal marginal coverage assumes exchangeability, which chronological shift may violate. Finite-sample ranks beyond calibration size produce unbounded intervals; descriptive test coverage is not a future guarantee.
Training range/category indicators describe extrapolation and cannot estimate an OOD probability or guarantee validity.
Nonlinear structured branches and linear modalities share retained cohorts, but have different capacities. Additional complexity does not guarantee improved performance.
Tree impurity importances summarize global behavior, may favor high-cardinality features, and are neither trial-specific SHAP values nor causal evidence.
Text uses TF-IDF; BioBERT, survival, and SHAP are optional separate capabilities and are not claimed as executed.
Completed-only analysis cannot estimate censored/ongoing trial outcomes without a separate survival cohort.

Per-phase test metrics are exploratory; small or one-class subgroups may be unstable or undefined. Scatter plots retain at most 200 chronological rows; metrics and reliability bins use every retained row.
